name: tmc
description: Language support for .tmc via tmt lsp: diagnostics, completions, navigation, formatting, semantic tokens.

tmt.lint.allow.description: Lint codes to allow (merged by union with tmt.json).

tmt.lint.warn.description: Opt-in lint codes to enable (e.g. state-may-trap). IDE-only; tmt.json has no warn key.

run.description: Run the target after building; `build` only.

target.description: Target-mode launch: a target name from the tmt.json project manifest. Built in process (the same driver `tmt build TARGET` uses) with debug info forced on regardless of the target's own profile. The tape comes from the target's own run block — a target with no run block, or a run block with no tape, fails to launch. Mutually exclusive with `program`.

project.description: Target mode only: where to start the tmt.json discovery walk (its own nearest-ancestor default otherwise — normally the workspace root).

program.description: Program-mode launch: path to a prebuilt .tmx executable, used as-is. Mutually exclusive with `target`. Build it with `tmt compile -g`/`tmt link` (or `tmt build --debug`) first — without debug info, breakpoints and stepping fall back to instruction granularity.

tape.description: Program mode only, and REQUIRED there: path to a .tmt tape snapshot. TM-1 has no empty-tape default (unlike PM-1's pmt), so program-mode launch fails without one.

stopOnEntry.description: Break before the first instruction runs, instead of running to the first breakpoint (or to completion).

trace.description: Stream a per-instruction trace line to the Debug Console as stderr output, matching `tmt run --trace`.

configurationSnippets.label: tmt: Launch target
configurationSnippets.description: Build and debug a tmt.json manifest target in process.

configurationSnippets.label: tmt: Launch program
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a prebuilt .tmx executable against a tape snapshot.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
